Hadith mein hai Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala zameen ko chamray ki tarah khench lega yahan tak ke har insaan ko sirf do qadam tikane ki jagah milegi. Sab se pehle mujhe bulaya jayega, Hazrat Jibraeel A.S Allah Ta'ala ki dayen janib honge, Allah ki qasam is se pehle us ne kabhi isay nahin dekha, toh main kahunga Allah, Jibraeel ne mujh se kaha tha ke yeh tere bheje hue mere paas aate hain, Allah farmayega sach kaha, toh main kahunga Allah phir mujhe shafa'at ki ijazat ho, chunancha Maqam-e-Mahmood mein khara ho kar main shafa'at karunga aur kahunga ke Allah tere in bandon ne zameen ke goshtay goshtay par teri ibadat ki hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Phir farmata hai ke zameen apne andar ke kul murday ugal degi aur khali ho jayegi, yeh bhi Rab ke farman ki muntazir hogi aur isay bhi yahi laiq hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke aye insaan tu koshish karta rahega aur apne Rab ki taraf aagay badhta rahega, aamal karta rahega yahan tak ke ek din us se mil jayega aur us ke samne khara hoga aur apne aamal aur apni sa'i-o-koshish ko apne samne dekh lega. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne farmaya aye Muhammad ﷺ jee le jab tak chahe bil-akhir maut aane wali hai, jis se chah-o-dil bastagi paida kar le ek din us se judai honi hai, jo chahe amal kar le ek din us ki mulaqat hone wali hai. Mulaqihi ki zameer ka marja baaz ne lafz-e-Rab ko bhi bataya hai toh ma'ani yeh honge ke Allah se teri mulaqat hone wali hai, woh tujhe tere kul aamal ka badla dega aur teri tamam koshish-o-sa'i ka phal tujhe ata farmayega, dono hi baatein aapas mein ek dusri ko lazim-o-malzoom hain. Qatada farmate hain ke aye Ibn-e-Adam tu koshish karne wala hai lekin apni koshish mein kamzor hai, jis se yeh ho sakay ke apni tamam tar sa'i-o-koshish nekiyon ki kare toh woh kar le, darasal neki ki qudrat aur buraiyon se bachne ki taqat bajuz imdad-e-Ilahi hasil nahin ho sakti. Phir farmaya jis ke dahine haath mein us ka aamal-nama mil jayega us ka hisab sakhti ke baghair nihayat aasani se hoga, us ke chotay aamal maaf bhi ho jayenge aur jis se us ke tamam aamal ka hisab liya jayega woh halakat se na bachega. Janab-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jis se hisab ka munaqsha hoga woh tabah hoga, toh Hazrat Ayesha R.A ne farmaya Quran mein toh hai ke nek logon ka bhi hisab hoga, aayat (Fasaufa yuhasabu hisaban yasira) 84.

Jab aap farigh hue toh main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh asan hisab kya hai? Farmaya sirf nama-e-aamal par nazar dal li jayegi aur keh diya jayega ke jao hum ne darguzar kiya lekin ae Ayesha jis se Allah hisab lene par aayega woh halak hoga (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Garaz jis ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal aayega woh Allah ke samne pesh hote hi chutti pa jayega aur apne walon ki taraf khush khush jannat mein wapas aayega. Aur jise peeth peeche se bayen hath mein hath mod kar nama-e-aamal diya jayega woh nuqsan aur ghate ki pukar pukarega halakat aur maut ko bulayega aur jahannam mein jayega. Duniya mein khoob hashash bashash tha be-fikri se maze kar raha tha aakhirat ka khauf aaqibat ka andesha mutlaq na tha ab is ko gham-o-ranj, yaas mehroomi-o-ranjeedgi aur afsurdagi ne har taraf se gher liya. Yeh samajh raha tha ke maut ke baad zindagi nahin. Ise yaqeen na tha ke laut kar Allah ke paas bhi jana hai. Phir farmata hai ke han han ise Allah zaroor dobara zinda kar dega jaise ke pehli martaba us ne ise paida kiya phir is ke nek-o-bad aamal ki jaza-o-saza dega bandon ke aamal-o-ahwal ki ise ittila hai aur woh unhein dekh raha hai.

Hud: 108). Yeh awwal raat se Isha ke waqt tak rehti hai. Aur ek riwayat mein hai ke murad suraj hai, ghaliban is matlab ki wajah is ke baad ka jumla hai to goya roshni aur andhere ki qasam khai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain din ke jaane aur raat ke aane ki qasam hai. Auron ne kaha hai safedi aur surkhi ka naam "shafaq" hai aur qaul hai ke yeh lafz in dono mukhtalif ma'non mein bola jata hai. Ke ek halat se dusri halat ki taraf charhte chale jaoge, Hazrat Anas farmate hain jo saal aayega woh apne pehle se zyada bura hoga. Main ne isi tarah tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai is hadith se aur upar wali hadith ke alfaaz bilkul yaksan hain. Bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh marfoo hadith hai. Un ki qira'at hai Latarkabunna. Sha'bi kehte hain matlab yeh hai ke ae Nabi tum ek aasman ke baad dusre aasman par charho ge, murad is se Me'raj hai, yani manzil ba-manzil charhte chale jaoge. Suddi kehte hain murad yeh hai ke apne apne a'maal ke mutabiq manzilein tay karo ge. Jaise hadith mein hai, ke tum apne se agle logon ke tariqon par charho ge bilkul barabar barabar yahan tak ke agar un mein se koi goh ke soorakh mein dakhil hua ho to tum bhi yahi karo ge, logon ne kaha aglon se murad aap ki kya Yahood-o-Nasrani hain? Hazrat Makhool farmate hain har bees saal ke baad tum kisi na kisi aise kaam ki ijaad karo ge jo is se pehle na tha, Abdullah farmate hain, aasman phate ga phir surkh rang ho jaye ga.

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.A) farmate hain yani bahut se log jo duniya mein past-o-zaleel thay aakhirat mein buland-o-zi-izzat ban jayenge, aur bahut se log duniya mein martabe aur izzat wale thay woh aakhirat mein zaleel-o-namurad ho jayenge. Ikrama (R.H) yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke pehle doodh peete thay phir ghiza khane lage, pehle jawan thay phir budhay huay. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain narmi ke baad sakhti, sakhti ke baad narmi, ameeri ke baad fakeeri, fakeeri ke baad ameeri, sehat ke baad bimari, bimari ke baad tandurusti. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Ibn-e-Adam ghaflat mein hai woh parwah nahin karta ke kis liye paida kiya gaya hai, Allah Ta'ala jab kisi ko paida karna chahta hai toh farishtay se kehta hai iski rozi, iski ajal, iski zindagi, uska badiya nek hona likh le phir woh farigh ho kar chala jata hai, aur dusra farishta aata hai aur uski hifazat karta hai yahan tak ke usay samajh aa jaye phir woh farishta uth jata hai phir do farishtay uska nama-e-aamal likhne wale aa jate hain. Maut ke waqt woh bhi chale jate hain aur Malakul Maut aa jate hain uski rooh qabz karte hain phir qabr mein uski rooh lauta di jati hai, Malakul Maut chale jate hain Qayamat ke din neki badi ke farishtay aa jayenge aur uski gardan se uska nama-e-aamal khol lenge, phir uske sath hi rahenge, ek saiq hai dusra shaheed hai phir Allah Ta'ala farmayega aayat (LAQAD KUNTA FEE GHAFLATIM MIN HAZA FAKASHAFNA ANKA GHITA'AKA FABASARUKAL YAUMA HADEED - 50. Qaf: 22) tu is se ghafil tha, phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat 'Latarkabunna' parhi yani ek haal se dusra haal phir farmaya logo tumhare aagay baray baray umoor aa rahe hain jin ki bardasht tumhare bas ki baat nahin lehaza Allah Ta'ala buland-o-bartar se madad chaho, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, munkar hadith hai aur iski sanad mein zaeef rawi hain lekin iska matlab bilkul sahi aur durust hai. Hud: 108). Aur ek riwayat mein hai ke murad suraj hai, ghaliban is matlab ki wajah is ke baad ka jumla hai to goya roshni aur andhere ki qasam khai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain din ke jaane aur raat ke aane ki qasam hai. Auron ne kaha hai safedi aur surkhi ka naam "shafaq" hai aur qaul hai ke yeh lafz in dono mukhtalif ma'non mein bola jata hai. Wasaq ke ma'ni hain jama kiya yani raat ke sitaron aur raat ke janwaron ki qasam, isi tarah raat ke andhere mein tamam cheezon ka apni apni jagah chale jana, aur chand ki qasam jabke woh poora ho jaye aur poori roshni wala ban jaye, Latarkabunna-kh ki tafsir Bukhari mein marfoo hadith se marwi hai. Ke ek halat se dusri halat ki taraf charhte chale jaoge, Hazrat Anas farmate hain jo saal aayega woh apne pehle se zyada bura hoga. Main ne isi tarah tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai is hadith se aur upar wali hadith ke alfaaz bilkul yaksan hain. Bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh marfoo hadith hai. (Allah A'lam) aur yeh matlab bhi isi hadith ka bayan kiya gaya hai ke is se murad zaat-e-Nabi hai (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur is ki ta'eed Hazrat Umar, Ibn-e-Masood, Ibn-e-Abbas aur aam Ahl-e-Makkah aur Ahl-e-Kufa ki qira'at se bhi hoti hai. Un ki qira'at hai Latarkabunna. Sha'bi kehte hain matlab yeh hai ke ae Nabi tum ek aasman ke baad dusre aasman par charho ge, murad is se Me'raj hai, yani manzil ba-manzil charhte chale jaoge. Suddi kehte hain murad yeh hai ke apne apne a'maal ke mutabiq manzilein tay karo ge. Jaise hadith mein hai, ke tum apne se agle logon ke tariqon par charho ge bilkul barabar barabar yahan tak ke agar un mein se koi goh ke soorakh mein dakhil hua ho to tum bhi yahi karo ge, logon ne kaha aglon se murad aap ki kya Yahood-o-Nasrani hain? Aap ne farmaya phir aur kaun? Hazrat Makhool farmate hain har bees saal ke baad tum kisi na kisi aise kaam ki ijaad karo ge jo is se pehle na tha, Abdullah farmate hain, aasman phate ga phir surkh rang ho jaye ga.

Phir bhi rang badalte chale jayenge, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain kabhi toh aasman dhuan ban jayega phir phat jayega. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.A) farmate hain yani bahut se log jo duniya mein past-o-zaleel thay aakhirat mein buland-o-zi-izzat ban jayenge, aur bahut se log duniya mein martabe aur izzat wale thay woh aakhirat mein zaleel-o-namurad ho jayenge. Ikrama (R.H) yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke pehle doodh peete thay phir ghiza khane lage, pehle jawan thay phir budhay huay. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain narmi ke baad sakhti, sakhti ke baad narmi, ameeri ke baad fakeeri, fakeeri ke baad ameeri, sehat ke baad bimari, bimari ke baad tandurusti. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Ibn-e-Adam ghaflat mein hai woh parwah nahin karta ke kis liye paida kiya gaya hai, Allah Ta'ala jab kisi ko paida karna chahta hai toh farishtay se kehta hai iski rozi, iski ajal, iski zindagi, uska badiya nek hona likh le phir woh farigh ho kar chala jata hai, aur dusra farishta aata hai aur uski hifazat karta hai yahan tak ke usay samajh aa jaye phir woh farishta uth jata hai phir do farishtay uska nama-e-aamal likhne wale aa jate hain. Maut ke waqt woh bhi chale jate hain aur Malakul Maut aa jate hain uski rooh qabz karte hain phir qabr mein uski rooh lauta di jati hai, Malakul Maut chale jate hain Qayamat ke din neki badi ke farishtay aa jayenge aur uski gardan se uska nama-e-aamal khol lenge, phir uske sath hi rahenge, ek saiq hai dusra shaheed hai phir Allah Ta'ala farmayega aayat (LAQAD KUNTA FEE GHAFLATIM MIN HAZA FAKASHAFNA ANKA GHITA'AKA FABASARUKAL YAUMA HADEED - 50. Qaf: 22) tu is se ghafil tha, phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat 'Latarkabunna' parhi yani ek haal se dusra haal phir farmaya logo tumhare aagay baray baray umoor aa rahe hain jin ki bardasht tumhare bas ki baat nahin lehaza Allah Ta'ala buland-o-bartar se madad chaho, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, munkar hadith hai aur iski sanad mein zaeef rawi hain lekin iska matlab bilkul sahi aur durust hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne in tamam aqwal ko bayan kar ke farmaya hai ke sahih matlab yeh hai ke aap (A.S) aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht sakht kamon mein ek ke baad ek se guzarne wale hain aur go khitab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hi hai lekin murad sab log hain ke woh Qayamat ki ek ke baad ek holnaki dekhenge, phir farmaya ke inhein kya ho gaya yeh kyun nahin iman late? Aur inhein Quran sun kar sajde mein gir padne se kaunsi cheez rokti hai, balkeh yeh kuffar toh ulta jhutlate hain aur haq ki mukhalifat karte hain aur sarkashi mein aur burai mein phanse hue hain, Allah Ta'ala in ke dilon ki baton ko jinhein yeh chupa rahe hain bakhoobi janta hai, tum aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhein khabar pahuncha do ke Allah Ta'ala ne in ke liye azab tayyar kar rakhe hain, phir farmaya ke in azabon se mehfooz hone wale behtareen ajar ke mustahiq imandar nek kirdar log hain, inhein pura pura baghair kisi kami ke hisab aur ajar milega, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (عَطَاۗءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوْذٍ) (11. Hud: 108). Baaz logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke bila ehsan lekin yeh ma'ani theek nahin har aan par lahza aur har waqt Allah Ta'ala Azza-o-Jal ke ahl-e-jannat par ehsan-o-inaam honge balkeh sirf us ke ehsan aur us ke fe'l-o-karam ki bina par inhein jannat naseeb hui na ke un ke a'mal ki wajah se pas us Malik ka toh hamesha aur mudam wala ehsan apni makhlooq par hai hi, us ki zaat-e-pak har tarah ki har waqt ki tareefon ke laiq hamesha hamesha hai, isi liye ahl-e-jannat par Allah ki tasbeeh aur us ki hamd ka ilham isi tarah kiya jaye jis tarah saans bila takleef aur be-takalluf balkeh be-irada chalta rehta hai, Quran farmata hai ayat (وَاٰخِرُ دَعْوٰىهُمْ اَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ) yani un ka aakhri qaul yahi hoga ke sab tareef jahano ke palne wale Allah ke liye hi hai, Alhamdulillah Surah Inshiqaq ki tafsir khatam hui. Allah hamein taufiq-e-khair de aur burai se bachaye, Ameen.
